name: IASM – AI Search Visibility Monitor
author: mediterraneaservices

sections.description:
IASM – AI Search Visibility Monitor helps you check whether key AI-oriented signals on your WordPress website are available and responding correctly.

AI systems can use multiple technical and content signals when discovering and interpreting websites. IASM provides a simple way to check the current availability and HTTP status of a defined set of AI-oriented files and endpoints.

What this plugin checks

IASM Free performs manual checks of:

  • llms.txt
  • humans.txt
  • metadata.json
  • sitemap-ia.xml
  • ai-plugin.json

The plugin verifies whether these signals are accessible and return a valid HTTP response.

IASM Free does not analyze the content of these files.

Why this matters

AI-oriented signals can form part of the technical information made available by a website for automated systems.

IASM helps you identify when supported signals are:

  • Available
  • Missing
  • Inaccessible
  • Returning an unexpected HTTP response

This gives you a quick snapshot of their current technical availability without checking each URL manually.

Who this plugin is for

  • Website owners preparing their sites for AI systems
  • SEO and AEO professionals
  • WordPress developers
  • Agencies managing WordPress websites
  • Businesses working on AI visibility and technical readiness

From manual checking to continuous monitoring

IASM Free shows you the current status of the supported signals when you run a manual check.

IA SEO Monitor Premium is a separate product designed for continuous monitoring.

Premium adds:

  • Automatic daily monitoring
  • Change detection and history
  • Alerts when the status of a monitored signal changes
  • AI Visibility Score™
  • AI Snapshot™
  • Impact Summary
  • AI Insights
  • AI Snapshot export and printing

IA SEO Monitor Premium can work independently on compatible WordPress websites.

When IA SEO Generator® is also installed, both products work complementarily: IA SEO Generator creates and maintains supported signals, while IA SEO Monitor Premium monitors their availability and status.

Learn more about IA SEO Monitor Premium:
https://iaseogenerator.com/producto/ia-seo-monitor-licencia-premium-suscripcion-anual/

Developed by the team behind IA SEO Generator.

Privacy

IASM – AI Search Visibility Monitor does not collect, store, or transmit personal data.

The checks in this Free version use WordPress’ HTTP API to request your own site’s public URLs (for example: /llms.txt, /sitemap-ia.xml) to verify their HTTP status codes.

No third-party services are contacted by the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open “IASM – AI Search Visibility Monitor” in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does IASM Free analyze the content of my website or AI-oriented files?

No. IASM Free checks the presence and HTTP status of the supported signals. It does not analyze their content.

Does IASM Free automatically monitor my website?

No. Checks in IASM Free are performed manually.

IA SEO Monitor Premium is a separate product that adds automatic daily monitoring, change detection, history and alerts.

What is the difference between IASM Free and IA SEO Monitor Premium?

IASM Free provides manual checks of supported AI-oriented signals.

IA SEO Monitor Premium adds automatic daily monitoring, change history, alerts, AI Visibility Score™, AI Snapshot™, Impact Summary, AI Insights, and AI Snapshot export and printing.

Does IA SEO Monitor Premium require IA SEO Generator?

No. IA SEO Monitor Premium can work independently on compatible WordPress websites.

When IA SEO Generator® is installed, the products work complementarily: IA SEO Generator creates and maintains supported signals, while IA SEO Monitor Premium monitors their availability and status.

Does IASM guarantee visibility or recommendations in AI systems?

No. IASM checks and monitors supported technical signals. It does not guarantee inclusion, citation, visibility or recommendation by any AI system.
